reliability.rationale: Persistence remains the development selection. The richer calibrated-yield model is only a retrospective winner, so a robust optical-transfer extension is not established.

mechanism.rationale: Signed photodiode current is not luminance; missing strain schedules, optical geometry and area prevent attribution to strain-dependent efficiency or degradation physics.

novelty.rationale: Targeted source-paper review is disclosed. These known model families and local extensions do not establish literature priority or a new fundamental law.

significance.rationale: A useful negative benchmark and acquisition-design lesson; current data do not support a reliable deployment-level optical law.

reproducibility.rationale: Exact states, native anchors and held-group results are present; independent computational replay is a separate review.

impact.rationale: No industrial deployment, intervention, measurement-cost experiment or external replication is included.

checks: Inspected all group results and baseline comparisons
Checked explicit calibration, target meaning and interpretation limits
limitations: Four held devices include only4 and37 eligible rows in two groups; composition, voltage, age and unmeasured strain remain confounded.
